PX25-04.name: The SixShieldConcluser Kei
PX25-04.effect:
You can set this card from the Trash.

[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Core])]
[During Set]
Including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, while you control any Contract Spirit/Contract Grandwalker Nexus, your set Bursts which include the color of those targets are unaffected by opposing effects.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can return a Burst card from your Trash to the Hand. When this effect returns any "Concluser" family card, for every 4 costs of the target, +1 core to any of your Grandwalker Nexuses.

PX24-04.name: The Bearer of Core Light, Viole Mai
PX24-04.effect:
[Core Charge: (Purple) (Core Charge via summon/advent only once per turn)]
◆When you summon/advent a target Spirit, you can +1 core to this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you do not control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, +1 core to this Nexus.

[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
+2 cores to this Nexus. Then, you can draw a card.

[Grand Skill: 2] [LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Send two cores from this Nexus to the Void) Send a core from any opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Reserve, and when depletes, your counter +1.

P15-11.name: The WhiteWaves WisdomKing
P15-11.effect:
[Burst: s] (After the opposing Hand increases due to an opposing effect)
If the opposing Hand is four or more, the opponent discards cards from their Hand until their Hand is three. After this effect resolves, summon this Spirit card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with a cost equal or inferior to this Spirit's.
